scope: Local macOS subprocess cleanup investigation; not target NPU evidence or a hardware archive entry
trigger: reports/pytest.log: no_mtp fixture cleanup PermissionError, cleanup_complete=false, exit_code=null

immediate_poll_retry_experiment.finding: poll() can still return None in the exit transition; an immediate group probe can raise EPERM again

implemented_policy: On group EPERM, poll and if needed wait at most 0.2 seconds for the known direct child, then probe the owned group once. Only ESRCH establishes absence. A live child wait timeout, persistent probe EPERM or a remaining group after signal denial still fails.
acceptance_boundary: No assertions relaxed; local cleanup repair does not establish NPU, graph, precision or performance acceptance
